feat: use explicit allowlist instead of transparency bump in whnfMatcher #13363

fixes yet another place in Lean where we used to do a transparency bump, and have decided now that it is best not to.

There are a variety of failures in Mathlib, which we've given ad hoc fixes to on the lean-pr-testing-13363 branch. Some of the fixes are fine, but some are not great, and should just be considered as emergency patches. I've labelled all of these clearly with #adaptation_notes.

Could I ask for some assistance properly repairing these proofs? The goal is to either:

  • decide the new proof is okay, and just remove the #adaptation_note
  • write a new proof (possibly changing the earlier API and adding simp lemmas to avoid the defeq problem that is now breaking the old proof)
  • or complain that this is a severe problem, and you think it warrants further attention on the lean4 side.

Currently, the fixes are only on the lean-pr-testing-13363 branch on the mathlib4-nightly-testing fork. You can either make a PR to that branch, send me a diff, push changes directly if you have write access, or ask me to add you to the nightly-testing Github team so that you have write access! (If you're confident pushing directly, please please do so, we'll have a chance to review this in the bump/ process.)

Later these fixes will arrive in Mathlib master (not certain yet whether this will be via an RC in the v4.30 series, or in v4.31.0-rc1), and I'll probably ping more widely for help at that stage for any remaining #adaptation_notes.

I'm now going to ping relevant people (the Authors list + recent committers) for the affected files. Sorry for the noise, of course helping here is not compulsory, and these problems can just join the technical debt backlog. :-)
